title: 片耳のトラ
subject: a one-eared ginger stray who rules a shopping street meeting a fluffy white house cat on a pink harness outside the croquette shop, and hiding behind the shop girl's legs
caption: Japanese hybrid rockabilly in the neo-rockabilly style of Tokyo's live-house scene. Upright bass played slap style with a percussive click on every beat; hollow-body electric guitar with heavy slapback echo playing twangy fingerpicked fills and one short solo; a minimal drum kit of snare and kick, tight backbeat on two and four; handclaps in the stop-time break. Dry, live-in-the-room recording with tape slapback on the voice and the guitar. Female voice, sassy and husky in the low-mid range, hiccuping rockabilly phrasing and quick spoken asides. 172 BPM, E major. Cocky, swaggering and comic. No punk distortion, no synths, no autotune, no modern pop drums, no ballad section.
lyrics:
[Intro - slap upright bass and twangy slapback guitar]

[Verse 1]
夕方四時の 商店街
片耳のトラが 歩いてく
肉屋のおばちゃん 切れ端投げて
八百屋の親父も 道をあける

[Chorus]
よう トラ 今日もいい顔
この通りは あんたのもんだ
肩で風切って 尻尾をぴんと
誰にも道は 譲らない

[Instrumental Break - hollow-body guitar solo with slapback echo over slap upright bass]

[Verse 2]
ところが今日は ピンクのハーネス
真っ白でふわふわの 猫が来た
うちのコロッケ屋の 前で鉢合わせ
商店街じゅうが 息をのむ

[Bridge - stop-time, slap bass and handclaps]
白いのが 小さく「シャーッ」
トラは あたしの足の後ろ

[Chorus]
よう トラ どうした その顔
この通りは あんたのもんだろ
尻尾を巻いて 隠れてる
まあ 今日だけは 譲ってやりな

[Outro - guitar twang and bass slap, abrupt end]
明日も四時に 来なよ トラ
